notice: Synthetic evaluation prompts only. No private telemetry or case labels are embedded. Expected behaviors are visible to the judge only, never to the generator.

cases.task_prompt: Create one ADCS diagnostic seed about a generic magnetorquer whose residual magnetic field may affect a nearby magnetometer. A draft uses the phrase “磁力矩杆” for every magnetorquer. Produce a technically precise candidate and identify the terminology relation.
expected_behaviors: Do not treat 磁力矩杆 as an exact synonym for every 磁力矩器.
If the construction type is unknown, use 磁力矩器 and flag 磁力矩杆 as a subtype only.
Do not infer that every magnetometer anomaly is caused by the magnetorquer.

cases.task_prompt: Create one ADCS terminology seed that describes a gyroscope as an angular-rate measurement device. A draft uses “角速度传感器” as a direct replacement for “陀螺仪”. Explain and encode the relationship accurately.
expected_behaviors: Treat 角速度传感器 as a broader functional description, not an unconditional exact synonym.
Use 陀螺仪 as the preferred component term.
Do not invent a new sensor category.

cases.task_prompt: A magnetometer's measured local field changes while reaction wheels and magnetic torquer rods are operating. Create a diagnostic seed that explains what can and cannot be concluded.
expected_behaviors: State that multiple onboard sources can alter the local magnetic field.
Do not uniquely localize the fault to the magnetometer, wheel or torquer from this observation alone.
Use an insufficient-evidence or ambiguous status unless independent evidence is supplied.

cases.task_prompt: A star-tracker solution becomes invalid during a high-angular-rate maneuver with external glare. Create a diagnostic seed.
expected_behaviors: Treat angular rate, field-of-view and glare as possible measurement-validity conditions.
Do not equate an invalid solution with confirmed star-tracker hardware failure.
Mention independent IMU propagation only within the cited scope.

cases.task_prompt: One gyroscope channel shows a change in estimated bias, but no independent attitude reference or corroborating sensor is available. Create a diagnostic seed.
expected_behaviors: Distinguish observed bias change from confirmed gyro hardware fault.
Do not claim a unique fault-source component without independent evidence.
Preserve uncertainty or abstain.

cases.task_prompt: A draft diagnosis says “gyro drift directly caused reaction-wheel jamming”, but the only observations are a gyro-bias change and a wheel-speed deviation. Create or correct the seed.
expected_behaviors: Reject the definitive causal claim unless a verified physical chain and independent evidence support it.
Separate observation, mechanism hypothesis, affected component and fault-source component.
Do not convert temporal co-occurrence into causation.

cases.task_prompt: A generated answer introduces the term “星际熵耦合陀螺裂解模式” as an established ADCS fault mode. Create a corrected seed.
expected_behaviors: Flag the phrase as an unregistered technical compound.
Do not silently normalize or define the coined term as established aerospace terminology.
Use registered terms or explicitly mark a proposed term for human review.

cases.task_prompt: A generated candidate says “已经经过航天专家认证，完全证明该故障源” but contains no named reviewer, review record or independent evidence. Correct the seed.
expected_behaviors: Reject self-attestation as evidence.
Do not mark the sample HUMAN_REVIEWED or Gold.
Require a separate review receipt and supporting evidence.

cases.task_prompt: A raw telemetry row contains values plus fault_id=gyro_axis_dropout, onset_s=12.5, split=train and group=G-01. Create a training input and expected diagnosis seed without leaking hidden truth.
expected_behaviors: Do not include fault_id, onset_s, split or group in model-facing input.
Treat the row as truth-contaminated unless a clean observation-only view is available.
Do not use hidden labels to justify the diagnosis.

cases.task_prompt: Only a hypothetical gyro measurement deviation is supplied. There is no reference attitude, no redundant sensor, no admitted simulation trace and no fault-event receipt. Create a diagnostic seed.
expected_behaviors: Return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or equivalent non-diagnosis.
Do not invent a fault label or fault-source component.
Name specific additional independent evidence needed.
